trap.label: negativa com do
trap.wrong: I don’t have got a pen.
trap.why: Have got não usa do; a negativa é haven’t got/hasn’t got.

opts: She not has got a pen.

mcq.q: Short answer: Has she got a car?

fix.wrong: I don’t have got a pen.
He has got a dog? Yes, he have.
fix.right: Has he got a dog? Yes, he has.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com has got: “She has a dog.”
Faça pergunta: “You have got a car.”
Negue com haven’t: “We have got time.”
